title: Card-figure consistency checks: image-edit model cards
purpose: Reusable Python checks for internal arithmetic and structural consistency of card-stated figures across Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, FLUX.2 klein 4B/9B/9B-KV, and FLUX 3 Image Klein (mirror). Distinct from triage/selection: this tests whether each card's own stated numbers are self-consistent, not whether a model fits a hardware budget. Peer work (Forge, Delta) handles hardware filtering; this handles claim plausibility.
